artifacts.notes: Complete page containing Tertia Pars q. 59, articles 1-6, on Christ's judiciary power, in English; article 5 asks whether a general judgment remains after the judgment that takes place in the present time. Restricted bytes not retained.
artifacts.rights_basis: newadvent.org pages carry a site copyright notice; no repository redistribution permission was established. The underlying English Dominican translation predates 1930 and is out of copyright in the United States, but these exact bytes are the site's presentation.

edition.notes: A dated delivery state of a public-domain-era translation on a copyrighted host, registered separately from the Prima Secundae pages already held under this work because the delivery state of one page proves nothing about another. Tertia Pars q. 59 is Aquinas's own text; it is the only place in the Summa proper where the judgment that takes place at death and the general judgment are compared. The translation is a working aid; the Latin governs wording-critical claims.
edition.publication: New Advent web presentation of the Summa theologica in the translation of the Fathers of the English Dominican Province (Benziger 1947 printing of the 1920 revised translation, as stated by the site); the single question page for Tertia Pars q. 59, retrieved 2026-07-25
